_meta.notes: T05 Communication: proximity text chat (range-limited) and world chat (global), both in MVP. Rate limits and log size configured here.

proximity_range_px.notes: Proximity chat range in world units; players outside range don't receive the message.

world_rate_msg_per_min.notes: World chat rate limit per player in messages per minute.

log_size.notes: Maximum number of chat log entries kept per session before dropping oldest.

message_max_chars.notes: Longest chat message the server accepts from one player, in characters.
